name: plan-p5-proof-otr
about: A planned campaign (V2c, prompt v5): the P5 starter preset written from the idea the Strategist recorded for "otr-many-facts" — the owner who still drives, which is the carrier's own line and no fact. Every candidate should lead with the idea and state only the brief's facts. The brief is that fixture's with "no-touch freight" and "pets allowed" as facts, where a real opening puts a listed benefit (openingSubjectMatter): as job details the copy may only quote them whole, and the first recording was refused for rewording them.

area.label: Fixture Yard, IL
area.reason: Fixture: drivers within a day's drive of the yard.

subject_matter.in_our_words: Family owned, and the owner still drives

recipe.name: On the road, in figures
recipe.hook_formula: Lead with one of the brief's own figures as evidence rather than a promise (the pay, or the miles), and put a second on the second line (the home time, or the bonus), so the two read side by side. If the brief states only one figure, the second line is the plainest fact beside it. Never round, never add a figure.
recipe.image_prompt_template: Our truck driving on {road} through {setting}, {viewpoint}, {light}, {season}, no text, no logos, no lettering

angle.idea: On a plain plate, lead with the owner who still drives, then name the daily details of the work as facts.
angle.proof: The carrier is family owned and the owner still drives; the job's details cover a pet in the cab and freight the driver does not unload.
